item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
What's New in Buzzy 1.0.5

  • New completion sounds: Choose a short Success Chime or Magic Sparkle, alongside the existing sound options.
  • Start / resume shortcut: Assign a keyboard shortcut to start an idle timer or resume a paused one.
  • Deferred updates: When an update finishes downloading, install it later from the menu bar popover or restart right away.
  • Break view polish: Refresh the break card with animated coffee steam and clearer activity tips.
